Price is still up 163% over the window and 2.46x over 30 minutes, and the drawdown from the 30-minute high is only 9.6%, so it has not started to unwind. Pool depth of about 160 SOL is deep enough that a $20 ticket will not move the price much.

The case is weaker than the headline numbers suggest. Early sell pressure was heavy, with a 0.79 sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes, and the recent buy-sell balance is only modestly positive. The class is UNRESOLVED, the curve and graduation data are missing, and the coin has no name or symbol, so I cannot assess its metadata or the creator. Against a base rate of roughly 20% losses on random post-graduation buys, the positive flow and low drawdown are the only evidence that demand persists. That is enough to make a case, but not a confident one.
